title: Balance without losing the medium
promptMarkdown: In basic aqueous solution, balance MnO₄⁻ + SO₃²⁻ → MnO₂(s) + SO₄²⁻ using half reactions. Show separate electron balances, cancel species, and check every atom and the net charge. Identify oxidant and reductant. State why formal balancing alone does not establish which manganese product dominates in a real solution.
hintLadder: Find Mn and S oxidation numbers before adding water.
Balance each half in acid, then neutralise H⁺ on both sides.
Use six electrons as the common multiple; check charge after cancelling.
